rows.label: qst610507_msg0004
rows.name:
I only took out half of them,
though...

rows.label: qst610507_msg0005
rows.name: Lucky you were here at the right time.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0006
rows.name:
We found them early, and our damage
seems minimal.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0007
rows.name:
I thought this place was a
bore, but maybe there are some
thrills to be had after all.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0008
rows.name:
Unlike the capital, this is the front
line.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0009
rows.name:
I'll put more effort into keeping
watch.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0010
rows.name: The commander sent you here, right?

rows.label: qst610507_msg0011
rows.name:
Everything's fine now, so report to
the commander at camp.

rows.label: qst610507_msg0012
rows.name:
Tell him Ishaq's working hard to
become the Bazuain of Temperantia.
